items.title: Add a pkg-based desktop CLI packaging pipeline
items.context: The desktop release needs a repeatable command that builds Koala and emits single-file executables for macOS, Windows, and Linux using the existing full bootstrap entrypoint rather than requiring users to install Node.js.
items.userSees: 发布维护者运行 `npm run package:desktop:host` 时看到 pkg build 输出，并在 `dist/desktop/` 下生成当前平台的 `koala-<platform>-<arch>` 可执行文件。

happy.desc: 在已构建源码后运行 host 打包命令会生成当前平台单文件 Koala 可执行程序。

edge.desc: dist/desktop 目录可重复生成，旧产物或缺目录不会导致命令失败。

adversarial.desc: 打包入口必须是完整 bootstrap，不能退化成 packages/main/dist/cli.js 的 core-only CLI。

items.title: Verify packaged executable behavior from the release artifact
items.context: The artifact must be smoke-tested directly so packaging gaps in dynamic imports, templates, or bundled assets are caught before desktop distribution.
items.userSees: 发布维护者运行 `npm run test:desktop-package` 后看到 `packaged executable smoke passed`，并能看到 smoke 直接调用了生成出来的二进制。

happy.desc: smoke 脚本会直接运行生成的二进制并验证 `status --help` 成功输出 Koala 帮助。

edge.desc: 当二进制尚未生成时，smoke 脚本给出明确的先运行 package 命令提示，而不是误报通过。

adversarial.desc: 若二进制启动失败、缺少 aux_doc_list 或输出 bootstrap 错误，smoke 脚本必须非零退出。

items.title: Document the desktop binary packaging workflow
items.context: Release maintainers need the exact commands, outputs, and caveats for Vercel pkg-based distribution, including the fact that pkg is a deprecated but useful early deployment path.
